lifecycle.additional_time: recordedStartTicks wait, queryProcessStartTicks up to 10000ms, kill command up to 10000ms; no claim 15000ms is a total wall bound. already-exited-but-promise-pending can take two post-kill waits.

current_result_codes.0: can also mean missing local child/exitPromise, not only proven clean exit
current_result_codes.124: timeout-killed label even when after-kill wait times out; does not prove death
current_result_codes.125: identity refused; do not kill or release
current_result_codes.other: natural process error / signal or exception; retain detailed result and ownership status

caller_counterexamples: shutdown awaits close but discards number, deletes seat, logs closed; at 8s can process.exit(0) before 10s escalation; second signal exits(1) immediately.
closeAndRelease retains 125 initially, but treats 124 as killed and releases despite helper not proving exit.
Codex/Grok clear child/session fields after returned 124/125; Claude clears child before await. A second close can return 0 and then release the still-uncertain instance.
transcript/state persistence after field clearing can throw; resulting failed Promise or failed state is not retained live-process custody.
lifecycle.required_host: The ONE gogoke ExecutionHost, not Room, owns close admission, full deadline, process identity, writer lease and durable residual receipt. WP01 defines typed results; WP02 owns durable custody; WP03 implements and verifies before any worker reuse.
lifecycle.release_policy: Only reconciled exact-identity direct exit AND descendant disposition AND no old writer AND durable receipt permit owner/home reuse. Kill return, Promise resolution, EOF, 0/124/125 alone never suffice. Preserve quarantine on host deadline, refusal, unknown identity, failed receipt or retry; no second-close shortcut.
lifecycle.deadline_policy: One monotonic host budget must account for grace, identity probe, kill command, after-kill observation and receipt commit. Shorter forced exit persists unresolved custody BEFORE exit; never silently release or declare zero success. Budget must not be solved by only increasing 8 to10.

remaining_runtime: All original runtime axes remain NOT_RUN; sources remain defective until authorized implementation. These are evidence closures proposed for focused review, not closed product defects.
prior_pass_b: The earlier PASS_FOR_DEFECT_CLOSURE with unprovable chronology is not acceptance authority. Latest received B rerun is CHANGES_REQUIRED at the original fixed A payload. Prior PF07 C is retained off-branch as unaccepted evidence; not silently imported.
